title: Debug a Python script interactively
summary: Start the Python debugger (pdb) to step through a script line by line. Useful for finding errors or understanding code flow.

steps.explain: Start the Python debugger (pdb) for the specified script.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the Python script to debug

steps.expect: The pdb prompt '(Pdb)' appears, allowing you to step through the code.
